Senses.PreferredTarget: to present the pivotal action within the phrase

Senses.Note: The first half locates the presentation inside the utterance, while the second names the mechanism or pivotal action presented there.

Occurrences.Kwic: 覺渾身泥水。這些子實處。諸人還知麼。看取雪竇頌。句裏呈機劈面來爍迦羅眼絕纖埃東西南北門相對無限輪鎚擊不開

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X79/X79n1557.xml). Essential Compendium of the United Lamp (聯燈會要). Speaker: Xuedou Chongxian.

Senses.Explanation: The phrase says that the mechanism or pivotal action is presented within the line. Xuedou adds that it comes straight to the face; Yunmen contrasts it with waiting and thinking. Xuedou says the mechanism presented in the line comes straight to the face; Yunmen says waiting and thinking are futile when it is presented there.
